description.value: Taqueria Playa Tropical is a Mexican restaurant and bar in New Westminster's 6th Street corridor, offering both dine-in and takeout with indoor and outdoor seating. The combination of a full bar and vegetarian menu options makes it a flexible stop for mixed groups. OSM records it as smoke-free with a check date of November 2024.
